title: Beard 2005 isolated-mitochondrion model, as corrected in 2006, as data

B05.cite: Beard DA (2005) A biophysical model of the mitochondrial respiratory system and oxidative phosphorylation. PLoS Comput Biol 1(4): e36
B05.licence: Creative Commons Attribution License (the article's own licence statement, read 19 November 2026)
B05.version_of_record: the PDF; the web XML's Eq. 22 and the sentence after it are stale (see Q06)

B06.cite: Beard DA (2006) Correction: A biophysical model of the mitochondrial respiratory system and oxidative phosphorylation. PLoS Comput Biol 2(1): e8
B06.licence: Creative Commons Attribution License (the correction's own licence statement, read 19 November 2026)

independence: Written from B05 and B06 alone (PDF read as images for every equation and both Table 1s; XML used for the text). No engine code, engine test, CellML, SBML or author code was read.
parameter_provenance: Each parameter carries its printed strings from B05's Table 1 ('e36') and from B06's corrected Table 1 ('e8'), per column (without / with phosphate control), with its class (A fitted, B literature, C set large), the equations it enters, and Table 1's sensitivity. The 2006 correction changed a parameter if and only if its two strings differ: nine do (Q13). The model uses e8.
charge_N_to_P_convention: positive charge moved from the matrix (N) to the outside (P) per turnover in the printed direction; it equals each flux's coefficient in Eq. 22's dPsi row

units.concentration: M (mol per litre of the compartment's water)
units.note: B05's 'Note on units': fluxes are per unit total mitochondrial volume; concentrations per compartment water volume

R.provenance: SI 2019 exact value; B05 states none

F.provenance: SI 2019 exact value (96485.33212 C mol^-1); B05 states none

T.provenance: UNREPORTED in B05 (Q24); declared 298.15 K because it reproduces the published P50 (0.373 uM) and the cytochrome c curves, where 310.15 K misses both (reproduction record); 310.15 K is run as the alternative

k_PiHt.what: co-transporter Michaelis constant for outside H2PO4-

X_K.unit: mol s^-1 mV^-1 M^-1 (l mito volume)^-1

X_Hle.unit: mol s^-1 mV^-1 M^-1 (l mito volume)^-1

k_Pi3.what: complex III phosphate constant (numerator); phosphate-control model only

k_Pi4.what: complex III phosphate constant (denominator); phosphate-control model only

n_A.what: protons moved inward per ATP made by F1F0

km_ADP.what: ANT saturation constant for outside free ADP

V_x.what: matrix water per unit mitochondrial volume

V_i.what: intermembrane-space water per unit mitochondrial volume (Q10)

gamma.what: outer-membrane area per unit mitochondrial volume (Q09)

C_IM.what: inner-membrane capacitance per unit mitochondrial volume

DGo_C1.provenance: B05 text after Eq. 3 and Table 2; reaction H+ + NADH + Q = NAD+ + QH2 at pH 7

DGo_C3.provenance: B05 text after Eq. 7 and Table 2; reaction QH2 + 2 cytC(ox) = Q + 2 cytC(red) + 2 H+ at pH 7

DGo_C4.provenance: B05 text after Eq. 9 and Table 2; reaction 2 H+ + 2 cytC(red) + 1/2 O2 = 2 cytC(ox) + H2O at pH 7

DGo_ATP.provenance: B05 Table 2, reaction H+ + ADP + Pi = ATP; the text after Eq. 11 prints -36.03 (Q01)

rbuff_coeff.provenance: B05 text after Eq. 22: rbuff^-1 = (100 M^-1)[H+]x

states.name: cytCred
states.where: intermembrane space (text); Eq. 22 prints subscript x (Q05)

Mg_i.note: free IMS Mg2+; no equation in B05 (Q26)

J_DH.reaction: NAD+ -> NADH + H+ (matrix; reductant not modelled)

J_C1.reaction: H+(x) + NADH + Q -> NAD+ + QH2 + 4 H+ moved x->e

J_C3.reaction: QH2 + 2 cytC(ox) -> Q + 2 cytC(red) + 2 H+(x) + 4 H+ moved x->e; 2 electrons x->i side

J_C4.reaction: 2 H+(x) + 2 cytC(red) + 1/2 O2 -> 2 cytC(ox) + H2O + 2 H+ moved x->e; 2 electrons i->x side

J_F1.reaction: H+(x) + ADP + Pi + n_A H+ moved e->x -> ATP (matrix)

J_ADPt.reaction: ADP buffer -> IMS (printed label J_ATPt, Q04)

J_ANT.expr: X_ANT*(ratio0(fADP_i, fADP_i + fATP_i*exp(-0.35*u)) - ratio0(fADP_x, fADP_x + fATP_x*exp(0.65*u)))*(fADP_i/(fADP_i + km_ADP))
J_ANT.printed_note: Eq. 14's last factor 1/(1 + k_m,ADP/[fADP]i) is written fADP_i/(fADP_i + k_m,ADP), identical for fADP_i > 0 and defined at 0; ratio0(a, b) = a/b, and 0 when b = 0 (then the factor is 0)
J_ANT.reaction: ADP3-(i) + ATP4-(x) -> ADP3-(x) + ATP4-(i), free forms; one negative charge leaves the matrix

J_PiHt.reaction: H2PO4-(i) + H+(i) -> H2PO4-(x) + H+(x) (stated 1:1 electroneutral co-transport)

J_Hle.printed_note: Eq. 19: X_Hle dPsi (H_e e^u - H_x)/(e^u - 1) with u = F dPsi/RT; written with bern(u) = u/(e^u - 1), bern(0) = 1, identical and defined at dPsi = 0

column.what: Table 1 column: with or without phosphate control of complex III

table.what: the 2006 corrected Table 1, or the 2005 original (a planted control)

DGo_ATP_sign.what: Q01: +1 takes Table 2's +36.03; -1 takes the text's -36.03

cytc_volume.what: Q05; steady states do not depend on it

H_x_row.what: Q06; the web XML's row is a planted control

low_oxygen_mvo2.provenance: B05 'Behavior of Model at Low Oxygen Concentration'

low_oxygen_cytc.provenance: B05 same section; the Fig. 6 caption says state 4 (Q08)

discrepancies.printed: text: DGo,ATP = -36.03 kJ/mol; Table 2: +36.03 for H+ + ADP + Pi = ATP
discrepancies.resolution: +36.03. Table 2 and Eq. 10's direction (synthesis) agree, and Eq. 11's exponent -(DGo,ATP - n_A DG_H)/RT gives a physical equilibrium only with +36.03; the text's -36.03 is the hydrolysis sign. The -36.03 reading is kept as a switch (DGo_ATP_sign = -1).

discrepancies.printed: Eq. 24 (phosphate control) drops Eq. 7's + 2RT ln([H+]x/10^-7) from the exponent; the text says only that Eq. 7 is 'modified' by the phosphate factor
discrepancies.resolution: Eq. 24 WITH Eq. 7's proton term. Decided by the published curves: with the term the phosphate-control model reproduces Figs. 4-5 at rms z 1.98 (Fig. 5 dPsi within 0.46 mV in both states); as typeset (switch 'eq24_printed') it misses dPsi by 1.1-2.7 mV (rms z 7.3). The typeset Eq. 24 omits a term the published results contain. As typeset, its zero is not reaction 6's equilibrium unless pH_x = 7 (audit).

discrepancies.where: Eq. 16 vs the text before it
discrepancies.printed: Eq. 16 pairs [H2PO4-]i with [H+]x and [H2PO4-]x with [H+]e; the text states 1:1 electroneutral co-transport of H+ and H2PO4-, and Eq. 22 books 2 H+ and 1 Pi into the matrix per turnover
discrepancies.resolution: Eq. 16 as printed: the published curves support it (the symport form, switch 'eq16_symport', worsens the match from rms z 1.98 to 3.58, mostly state-3 MVO2 and cytochrome c, and at every matrix Mg2+ total from 0.25 to 15 mM). So this is the model as run, not a typesetting slip. As printed, the flux is proportional to [HPO4 2-]i - [HPO4 2-]x: its zero is equal HPO4 2- on both sides, not the booked co-transport's equilibrium, and it dissipates negatively in part of state space (audit).

discrepancies.printed: labelled J_ATPt but carries ADP
discrepancies.resolution: J_ADPt, as Eq. 22 uses it

discrepancies.printed: d[cytC(red)2+]x/dt = (2J_C3 - 2J_C4)/V_x, while the text and Table 1 place cytochrome c in the intermembrane space at 2.70 mM, ten times the matrix-referred value 'since the IM volume is assumed to be 1/10 of the mitochondrial water volume'
discrepancies.resolution: Published arm divides by V_x as printed; V_i is a switch. Steady states are identical; only the cytochrome c relaxation time changes (by V_x/V_i = 9).

discrepancies.where: Eq. 22 row 1 and the sentence after it; PDF vs web XML
discrepancies.printed: PDF Eq. 22: +J_DH -(4+1)J_C1 -(4-2)J_C3 -(2+2)J_C4; PDF sentence: 'a total of three matrix H+ consumed' with coefficients -(4+1), -(4-2), -(2+2), naming complex I's reaction as complex III's. Web XML Eq. 22 and sentence: -J_DH -(4-1)J_C1 -(2+2)J_C3 -(4-2)J_C4
discrepancies.resolution: PDF Eq. 22. Its coefficients follow from reactions 2, 6 and 8 (protons pumped plus protons consumed or released), and with them the matrix charge is conserved exactly together with dPsi (the exact left null space, model.conservation_laws). The web XML row breaks that invariant; it is kept as a planted control.

discrepancies.printed: 4J_C1 + 2J_C3 + 4J_C4 - n_A J_F1 - J_ANT - J_Hle - J_K - 2J_Mg = 0, but no J_Mg is defined and Eq. 22's dPsi row has none
discrepancies.resolution: J_Mg = 0; the text also says the best fits set passive K+ and Mg2+ fluxes to zero

discrepancies.printed: caption: cytochrome c curve for state-4 conditions, refs [17]-[19]; text: state 3 with [ADP]e = 0.5 mM and [ATP]e = 0.87 mM, Wilson et al. [19]; O2 curve refs [20],[21]
discrepancies.resolution: the text's conditions

discrepancies.printed: text after Eq. 13: outer-membrane area per total cardiomyocyte cell volume; Table 1 and 'Parameter values': per mitochondrial volume
discrepancies.resolution: per mitochondrial volume, which keeps Eq. 13's flux in the stated units

discrepancies.printed: Table 1: 'IM water fraction per total cell volume'; footnote f: IMS is 10% of mitochondrial volume, and 0.0715 = 0.10 x 0.715 as 0.6435 = 0.90 x 0.715
discrepancies.resolution: per mitochondrial volume

discrepancies.printed: reaction 10 consumes a matrix H+ (and Eq. 22 books n_A - 1), and Table 2's DGo,ATP is at pH 7, but Eq. 11 carries no [H+]x/10^-7 factor
discrepancies.resolution: Eq. 11 as printed: the published curves support it (adding the proton factor, switch 'eq11_with_proton_term', worsens the match from rms z 1.98 to 3.55, and at every matrix Mg2+ total from 0.25 to 15 mM). The rate law's zero sits RT ln(10^-7/[H+]x) from reaction 10's equilibrium, about +0.5 kJ/mol at the model's matrix pH (audit).

discrepancies.printed: Introduction and Discussion: 16 adjustable parameters, nine curves; 'Parameter values' and Results: 14 adjustable parameters, seven curves; Table 1 lists 16 class-A rows including k_Pi,3 and k_Pi,4
discrepancies.resolution: 16 class A for the phosphate-control model and 14 for the model without it; no effect on the equations
the 2006 values (B06 replaces Table 1); the text's C_IM of 6.75e-6 agrees with B06

discrepancies.printed: 'inorganic potassium concentrations were set as constants'
discrepancies.resolution: read as inorganic phosphate

discrepancies.where: Eqs. 11, 18 and 22 (found by the audit, not a printed contradiction)
discrepancies.printed: Eq. 11 reads the Mg-bound forms (mADP, mATP) and Eq. 18 the IMS totals at a fixed apparent K_AK, but Eq. 22 books F1F0's turnover on the matrix totals, so the free forms absorb it while the bound pools change only by binding
discrepancies.resolution: kept as printed: the rate law's driving force equals the booked reaction's only at Mg2+-binding equilibrium, which X_MgA = 1e6 keeps to within numerical precision and which holds exactly at every steady state; a rapid binding closure (departure D1) removes the distinction
discrepancies.affects: transients far from binding equilibrium (free forms can go negative from a non-equilibrated start)

discrepancies.printed: RT appears throughout; no temperature is stated
discrepancies.resolution: UNREPORTED input: declared 298.15 K, selected between two candidates (298.15 and 310.15 K) by the published P50 and cytochrome c curves; 310.15 K misses cytochrome c by a near-constant factor of 1.33 and P50 by a factor of 2

discrepancies.printed: none are reported; Eq. 22 conserves the matrix Mg2+ total and a matrix charge combination, so steady states depend on two initial inventories
discrepancies.resolution: UNREPORTED input: the matrix Mg2+ total is declared (1 mM; a scan over 0.25-15 mM fits the published curves best near 5 mM, the buffer's total and B05's only Mg2+ number: rms z 1.40 against 1.98 at 1 mM). The matrix charge inventory is anchored to one published matrix pH (Fig. 4D at [Pi]e = 0, 7.1418), giving -0.018154 mol per l mito at 298.15 K; the other matrix pH values are predictions. Three far-apart starts with equal inventories reach one steady state (to 4e-13).
discrepancies.affects: matrix pH, K+, and through them every output

discrepancies.printed: not a state and no equation; the buffer's total Mg2+ is 5.0 mM
discrepancies.resolution: UNREPORTED input: declared as the buffer's free Mg2+ from its 5.0 mM total and the buffer's nucleotides at Table 1's constants; 5.0 mM free is the alternative

discrepancies.printed: [Pi]e is not stated for either low-oxygen curve
discrepancies.resolution: UNREPORTED input: [Pi]e = 10 mM reproduces the published P50 (0.3751 against 0.373 uM); 1 mM gives 0.451 uM

discrepancies.printed: MVO2 in mol O2 per min per mol cytochrome a; no cytochrome a content per mitochondrial volume is given
discrepancies.resolution: UNREPORTED conversion: compared as ratios, and one anchor fixes the scale for display
